verdict.rationale: Cekura is a SaaS testing and observability platform, so an official MCP server is an applicable axis. The evidence shows it ships one: a dedicated MCP overview page says to install Cekura Skills and MCP so an AI assistant can design, run, and improve evaluations, and a probe confirms the official MCP server is documented. The plugin bundles the MCP config, and an agent-integration guide covers Claude Code, Cursor, and VS Code. Missing for 10: detail on the MCP tool surface, auth and transport, and independent or hands-on corroboration that the server works as described.
